transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I understand we're here to discuss the prior-learning credit petition from the student who's seeking college credit based on their work experience in biological laboratory operations. Before I make my binding decision, I'd like to follow our standard process. Could we hear from the faculty assessor on their report, and from the registrar on the records review? I want to make sure we have all the information we need before finalizing this decision ahead of the student's upcoming transcript review.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I completed the faculty assessment this week. The portfolio and observed practical together demonstrate the competencies for exactly 6 credits. However, I want to be clear that this credit recommendation is valid only if the observed practical is included alongside the portfolio as part of the assessment record.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: During my records review, I confirmed in the state articulation record that these competencies must be posted as course equivalency BIO-115 with a CR transcript notation, rather than as general biology elective credit or a letter grade.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: The observed practical will be included alongside the portfolio as part of the official assessment record, as required by the faculty assessor's recommendation.
Credits will be posted as course equivalency BIO-115 with a CR transcript notation, not as general biology elective credit or a letter grade.
